title: Lost Mary Airplane Mode Mix Berries Nic Film - 2mg/ Strip - 20pk
description: Lost Mary Mixed Berries Nicotine Films combine the taste of ripe, tangy berries with the convenience of a smoke-free format. These slim films dissolve under the lip, providing fast-acting nicotine without any smoke, vapour or lingering odour. Ideal for discreet use, each film contains 2mg of nicotine and delivers satisfaction in under 20 minutes. They’re comfortable, mess-free and easy to carry—perfect for when you need a quick, clean alternative. Place the film directly on to your tongue and let it dissolve over time. Dispose of packaging responsibly after use. How to Use: Nicotine Strips Please Note: Do not chew, suck or swallow these pouches – they’re only designed to be placed behind your top lip.
